name: Medical Necessity — Total Hip Arthroplasty (High Complexity)
description: Medical necessity denial for THA with complex comorbidities. Requires detailed clinical documentation and specialty society guidelines.

denial.denialLetterText:
Centene
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: May 1, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 27130 (Total hip arthroplasty)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: CO16 — Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s)

PAYER STATEMENT: Service not medically necessary based on clinical guidelines. The submitted documentation does not demonstrate that conservative treatment was attempted and failed for a minimum of 6 months.

PROCEDURE: 27130 — Total hip arthroplasty
DIAGNOSIS: M16.11 — Primary osteoarthritis, right hip

APPEAL RIGHTS: You have the right to appeal this denial within 120 days.

APPEAL DEADLINE: August 29, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
Centene
